Decisions: Tokenizer uses regex /[A-Za-z0-9]+(?:'[A-Za-z0-9]+)*/g on normalized text, returns match array or empty array. No shadowing of normalize. No stopwords, preserve negation words. integrator: Final state: pipeline.js complete and correct. processText calls injected tokenize(text) exactly once.
